title: GDD T-102 — SessionStateMachine: full session FSM with per-state timeouts (§2.1/§2.2)
description: Extend/wrap the existing RoundPhaseMachine (Barcade.Core — do NOT rewrite it; add states, per Annex D.1) into a SessionStateMachine covering the full GDD §2.1 graph: ATTRACT -> JOIN -> (BOARD_MOVE -> BOARD_RESOLVE -> MG_INTRO -> MG_PLAY -> MG_RESULT -> INTERMISSION)* -> FINAL_WAGER -> FINAL_MG -> GAME_OVER -> ATTRACT. Board states are part of the FSM now but pass through as stubs until BoardModel (Hito 4) is wired. FSM invariants from the GDD: no transition ever blocks on input (every state has a timeout, §2.2 budget table); MG_PLAY is the only state where gameplay input reaches the active microgame; state serializes per tick for deterministic replay (§13). JOIN: each player claims a color with a button press, needs >= 2 ready players, 30 s timeout; GAME_OVER returns to ATTRACT after 20 s. Read GDD §2 before coding.
acceptance_criteria: SessionStateMachine implements every state and transition of GDD 2.1 including JOIN color-claim (>=2 players, 30 s timeout), the round loop, FINAL_WAGER, FINAL_MG, and GAME_OVER (20 s timeout back to ATTRACT)
Every state has a timeout from the GDD 2.2 budget table and a session driven with zero input still reaches GAME_OVER (no state can be blocked by an absent player)
Only MG_PLAY forwards gameplay input to the active microgame; all other states accept only confirmation taps / minimal navigation
BOARD_MOVE and BOARD_RESOLVE exist as pass-through stubs (advance in <= 1 tick when no board model is wired) so Hito 4 slots in without changing the FSM shape
FSM state is a serializable POCO and the machine is deterministic: same (seed, input sequence) produces an identical state trace (replay test)
Existing RoundPhaseMachine consumers keep compiling and passing (extension, not rewrite)
Tests-first: failing fast-suite tests for the invariants above committed strictly before implementation; suite green after with no regression

comments.body: Delivered tests-first on master by dev-t101: 2744481 test(core) red — SessionStateMachineTests.cs (16 tests) + SessionPhase/SessionStateSnapshot/SessionStateMachineConfig POCOs + csproj registration, deliberately WITHOUT SessionStateMachine.cs; genuine compile-red captured by removing the not-yet-committed impl file from disk: CS0246 'SessionStateMachine' x16 (one per test), supporting types compiled clean -> d7f5324 feat(core) green. Suite 449 -> 465 (16 new). RoundPhaseMachineTests standalone 25/25 unchanged (AC6). DESIGN: composition — RoundPhaseMachine completely untouched; SessionStateMachine owns a private instance (intermissionDuration:0, zero-duration inner Intermission flushed with Tick(0f) after StartRound()) reused only for the MgIntro/MgPlay/MgResult sub-loop; external result-window timer on Result entry (same pattern as MicrogameLoopController); FinalMg NOT routed through RoundPhaseMachine (GDD draws it as one box). Fixed-tick 60 Hz Tick() feeding constant 1/60 s inward. TIMEOUTS: Join 30 s OR >=2 ready (GDD 2.1); MgIntro 0.8 s, MgResult 1.5 s, Intermission 2 s (GDD 2.2 exact); MgPlay per-call playDurationSeconds default 5 s; FinalWager 5 s (GDD 6.2); GameOver 20 s; Board* <=1-tick stubs per AC4. ASSUMPTIONS (all [ASSUMED]-tagged + test-pinned): (1) Join with 0 ready advances on its own 30 s timeout, never loops to Attract (orchestrator pre-approved, decision in bundle; pinned Join_ZeroReadyPlayers_StillAdvancesAfterTimeout); (2) FinalMg receives gameplay input alongside MgPlay — AC3's literal 'Only MG_PLAY' read as MG_PLAY-equivalence for the climax round, else FINAL_MG is unplayable; pinned GameplayInput_OnlyForwardedDuringMgPlayOrFinalMg; FLAGGED FOR REVIEWER; (3) TotalRounds default 7 from Annex B session.rounds (5-8); (4) FinalMg duration reuses per-call playDurationSeconds (GDD gives no FinalMg number; 9.1's 1.5x is a difficulty scalar); (5) GetResult() only called when IsFinished genuinely true — ceiling cutoff leaves LastMicrogameResult null, fake throws if called early; (6) no microgame injected -> MgPlay/FinalMg skip within a tick. InputInterpreter Reset() fires on MgIntro/FinalMg entry (T-101 seam; currently black-box-unobservable, documented). Two self-caught test-authoring bugs fixed inside the feat commit (not separate): FullGraph snapshot off-by-one (recorded after InsertCredit instead of before); zero-alloc test had Assert.That INSIDE the measured window (NUnit constraint machinery allocates — 371200 bytes) -> plain-bool tracking, asserts strictly after window, now 0 bytes. Files: Core/Runtime/Loop/{SessionPhase,SessionStateSnapshot,SessionStateMachineConfig,SessionStateMachine}.cs (+metas), Tests/EditMode/SessionStateMachineTests.cs (+meta), fast-tests csproj. ENV NOTE: system PATH dotnet is runtime-only; use $HOME/.dotnet/dotnet (SDK 8.0.422).

comments.body: FULL-depth fresh-context review (rev-t024) of 259c3e1..d7f5324, evidence pinned at d7f5324 in a detached worktree: APPROVE-WITH-NITS — 0 HIGH, 3 MEDIUM, 4 LOW. MEDIUM-1: CompleteJoin() fires the instant the 2nd seat claims (SessionStateMachine.cs:299) — in a 4-player group, seats 3/4 pressing one tick later never join; GDD 9.3 budgets up to 30 s for color choice and the 2.1 exit label is ambiguous; only interpretation in the diff with NO [ASSUMED] tag and no design ruling. MEDIUM-2: MgIntro 0.8 s wiring unpinned — config VALUE pinned but if the constructor arg were dropped and RoundPhaseMachine's 1.0 s default took over, all 465 tests still pass (silent-drift shape); same smaller gap for MgResult's external 1.5 s window; fix = exact tick-count tests against distinctive config values. MEDIUM-3: difficultyMult hardcoded 1f at both Initialize call sites, unflagged, while SessionPhase doc itself cites D_final=1.5x; scope-fine (difficulty is T-108) but needs [ASSUMED] seam comment + pin. LOW-1 stale LastMicrogameResult when mgIntroSeconds=0 AND playDuration=0 (flush cascades past the arrival-capture block; unreachable with GddDefaults). LOW-2 ResetToAttract does not clear _roster. LOW-3 input-boundary test holds by exact cancellation at window edges; assertion message overstates. LOW-4 record-keeping (15 vs 16 CS0246). ASSUMPTION AUDIT: (a) JOIN 0-ready timeout PASS per approved semantics; (b) FinalMg gameplay input ACCEPTED (GDD draws FINAL_MG with no sub-phases; denying input makes climax unplayable; documented + pinned); (c) TotalRounds=7 PASS (Annex B line 903 verified); (d) FinalMg duration reuse PASS; (e) GetResult gating PASS; (f) null-microgame skip PASS; (g) 0.8 s override PARTIAL -> MEDIUM-2. RISK AREAS: in-feat test edits both legitimate and strictly strengthening; Tick(0f) flush advances exactly one phase, no double-advance; AC5 snapshot pure readonly struct, replay compares full 2001-snapshot traces field-by-field; zero-alloc window LIVE (not a 4th vacuous incident); liveness verified incl. never-finishing microgame and FinalMg ceiling; interpreter Reset at BeginRound/BeginFinalMg matches 3.2; five HIGH classes swept — none; calibration audit: every GDD citation checked accurate, [ASSUMED] tags sit exactly where the GDD is silent. TIER AUDIT: tdd correct and honored. AC-by-AC: all 7 pass (AC3 as [ASSUMED]-amended; AC2 with the MEDIUM-2 sensor caveat). Disposition: fix round for MEDIUM-1 (needs orchestrator design ruling), MEDIUM-2, MEDIUM-3, LOW-1/2/3; LOW-4 recorded here, no action. rev-t024 re-verifies the fix diff.
